descriptionVi: Đề rút gọn theo cấu trúc TOEIC: ngữ pháp, nghe ngắn và đọc thông báo.
descriptionEn: A shortened TOEIC-style test: grammar, short listening and notices.

questions.content: The manager asked all staff to ____ the report by Friday.
questions.explanation: Sau "asked ... to" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.content: Ms. Lee is responsible ____ training new employees.
Our new office is ____ than the old one.
questions.explanation: So sánh hơn của tính từ ngắn: larger.

questions.content: Please ____ me know if you cannot attend the meeting.
The invoice must be paid ____ thirty days.
The company announced a ____ increase in sales this quarter.
questions.explanation: Cần tính từ đứng trước danh từ "increase".

questions.content: Mr. Tan, ____ works in the finance department, will lead the project.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ chỉ người, làm chủ ngữ: who.

questions.content: We regret to ____ you that the flight has been cancelled.
questions.explanation: "inform someone that ..." là cấu trúc đúng.

questions.content: All applicants must ____ a valid passport.
questions.explanation: Sau "must" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu: present.

questions.content: The seminar has been ____ until next Monday.
questions.explanation: Bị động thì hoàn thành: has been + V3.

questions.content: He has worked here ____ 2019.
If the shipment ____ on time, we will meet the deadline.
questions.explanation: Câu điều kiện loại 1: mệnh đề If dùng hiện tại đơn.

questions.content: Complete with the correct form of "decide": The board has ____ to open a new branch.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành: has + decided.

questions.content: Complete with one word: Please fill ____ the form and return it.
questions.explanation: "fill out/in a form" = điền vào mẫu đơn.

questions.content: Complete with one word: I look forward ____ hearing from you.
Complete with one word: The meeting starts ____ 9 a.m.

Listen: "The meeting has been moved from two o'clock to three thirty."
When is the meeting now?

Listen: "Man: Is the printer working? Woman: No, the technician is coming tomorrow morning."
When will the technician come?

Listen: "Your flight to Osaka now boards at gate B7."
Where does the flight board?

Listen: "The sale ends on Sunday, and all items are thirty percent off."
How much is the discount?

Listen: "Woman: Could you send me the sales report? Man: Sure, I'll email it after lunch."
When will the man send the report?

Listen: "The restaurant is fully booked tonight, but there is a table free at nine tomorrow."
What does the speaker offer?
questions.explanation: Tối nay hết chỗ, đề nghị bàn lúc 9 giờ mai.

questions.content:
Read: "Notice: The staff parking lot will be closed for repairs from June 3 to June 5. Please use the visitor lot on Oak Street."
Where should staff park during the repairs?
questions.explanation: Nhân viên dùng bãi khách trên phố Oak.

options.content: In the visitor lot on Oak Street

questions.content:
Read: "Email: Dear Mr. Green, thank you for your order #4521. It will be shipped on Monday and should arrive within three working days."
When should the order arrive?

Read: "Job ad: We are looking for a part-time receptionist. Experience is preferred but not required. Send your CV to hr@brightco.com by May 20."
What is stated about experience?

Read: "Memo: All employees must complete the safety training before the end of the month. Sessions are available on Tuesday and Thursday."
What must employees do?
questions.explanation: Phải hoàn thành đào tạo an toàn.

questions.content:
Read: "Hotel notice: Breakfast is served from 6:30 to 10:00 in the garden restaurant. Guests staying in suites receive a free drink."
Who receives a free drink?
questions.explanation: Chỉ khách ở phòng suite được tặng đồ uống.

questions.content:
Read: "Email: Hi Anna, I'm sorry I missed your call. I'm in meetings all day, but I can talk at 5:30 if that suits you."
Why did the writer miss the call?

Read: "Advertisement: Fresh Bites Café opens on 1 July. The first fifty customers will receive a free coffee."
What is offered to the first fifty customers?

Read: "Notice: Due to maintenance, the elevator in Building B will be out of service on Saturday. Use the stairs or the elevator in Building A."
What should people do on Saturday?
questions.explanation: Thang máy tòa B ngừng hoạt động.

options.content: Use the stairs or the Building A elevator

descriptionVi: Đề rút gọn thứ hai với tình huống công sở và du lịch.
descriptionEn: A second shortened test with workplace and travel situations.

questions.content: The new policy will take ____ next month.
Please submit your expense report ____ the end of the week.
questions.explanation: "by" + mốc thời gian = chậm nhất vào lúc đó.

questions.content: The CEO is ____ for the annual meeting next week.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: is preparing.

questions.content: Neither the manager ____ the assistants were informed.
This machine is ____ than that one.
questions.explanation: So sánh hơn của tính từ dài.

questions.content: Customers can return any item ____ a receipt.
The contract was signed ____ both parties.
questions.explanation: Bị động chỉ người thực hiện: by.

questions.content: She has been the team leader ____ five years.
We need someone ____ can speak Japanese.
questions.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ.

questions.content: The store offers a ____ discount to loyal customers.
questions.explanation: Cần tính từ bổ nghĩa cho "discount".

questions.content: Because of heavy rain, the outdoor event was ____.
I would appreciate it if you could ____ me a quote.
questions.explanation: Sau "could" dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.content: Complete with one word: The train arrives ____ platform 3.
Complete with the correct form of "success": The launch was very ____.
Complete with one word: She apologised ____ the delay.
Complete with one word: We are pleased ____ announce a new product.

Listen: "Attention passengers: the ferry to Green Island leaves at eight fifteen from pier two."
Which pier does the ferry leave from?

Listen: "Woman: How was the conference? Man: Very useful, but the hotel was too far from the venue."
What was the problem?
questions.explanation: Vấn đề là khách sạn quá xa.

options.content: The hotel was far from the venue

questions.content:
Listen: "The library will close early on Friday at four p.m. for a staff meeting."
Why will the library close early?

Listen: "Man: I'd like to book a room for two nights. Woman: A double or a single? Man: A single, please."
Which room does the man book?

Listen: "Today's special is grilled fish with vegetables for twelve dollars."
How much is the special?

Listen: "Woman: The presentation starts in ten minutes. Man: I'll get the laptop from my office."
What will the man do?

Read: "Notice: Free Wi-Fi is available in the lobby. The password can be requested at the front desk."
How can guests get the password?
questions.explanation: Mật khẩu xin ở quầy lễ tân.

questions.content:
Read: "Email: Thank you for applying. We would like to invite you to an interview on Thursday at 10 a.m. Please bring your ID."
What should the applicant bring?

Read: "Ad: Summer sale! Buy two T-shirts and get the third one free. Offer valid until August 31."
What is the offer?

Read: "Memo: The annual staff party will be held on December 12 at the Riverside Hotel. Please confirm attendance by December 1."
What should staff do by December 1?

Read: "Sign: Please do not park in front of the loading dock. Vehicles will be towed at the owner's expense."
What will happen to vehicles parked there?

Read: "Email: Dear Ms. Park, your subscription will expire on March 31. Renew before that date to keep your 10% discount."
Why should Ms. Park renew before March 31?
questions.explanation: Gia hạn sớm để giữ ưu đãi 10%.

questions.content:
Read: "Notice: The gym is open from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. on weekdays and from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on weekends."
When is the gym open on weekends?

Read: "Article: The city plans to build a new bridge to reduce traffic. Construction will begin next spring and take two years."
How long will construction take?

descriptionVi: Đề rút gọn: đọc True/False/Not Given, từ vựng học thuật, nghe và ngữ pháp.
descriptionEn: A shortened test: True/False/Not Given reading, academic vocabulary, listening and grammar.

questions.content:
Passage: Honey never spoils. Archaeologists have found edible honey in ancient Egyptian tombs that is over three thousand years old.
Statement: Honey found in Egyptian tombs was still edible.
questions.explanation: Đoạn văn nói mật ong vẫn ăn được.

questions.content:
Passage: Coffee was first grown in Ethiopia, but it became popular in Europe in the seventeenth century.
Statement: Coffee was first grown in Europe.
questions.explanation: Cà phê được trồng đầu tiên ở Ethiopia.

questions.content:
Passage: The city library offers free classes in computer skills to adults. Classes are held on weekday evenings.
Statement: The classes are also held at weekends.
questions.explanation: Bài không nhắc tới cuối tuần.

questions.content:
Passage: Electric cars produce no exhaust fumes, but their batteries require rare metals that are difficult to mine.
Statement: Electric cars produce exhaust fumes.

Passage: In a survey of 1,000 students, sixty percent said they studied better in the morning.
Statement: Most students in the survey preferred studying in the morning.

Passage: The museum's new exhibition on ancient Rome opens in March. Tickets can be booked online.
Statement: The exhibition will be open for six months.
questions.explanation: Không có thông tin về thời gian mở cửa.

questions.content:
Read: "Bees communicate the location of flowers by performing a "waggle dance". The angle of the dance shows the direction, and its length shows the distance."
What does the length of the dance show?
questions.explanation: Độ dài điệu nhảy cho biết khoảng cách.

questions.content:
Read: "Because plastic takes hundreds of years to break down, many countries are banning single-use bags."
Why are countries banning single-use bags?

Read: "Although the town's population has doubled in ten years, public transport has hardly improved. As a result, most residents now rely on cars."
What is the result of poor public transport?
questions.explanation: "As a result, most residents now rely on cars".

questions.content:
Read: "The Great Barrier Reef, off the coast of Australia, is the largest coral reef system in the world."
The Great Barrier Reef is located off the coast of ____.
questions.explanation: Rạn san hô nằm ngoài khơi Úc.

questions.content: Choose the word closest in meaning to "reluctant":
The government introduced new ____ to reduce air pollution.
"A sharp decline" means:
Choose the antonym of "scarce":
Many young people find it hard to ____ a balance between work and study.
The company's profits have ____ steadily since 2020.
questions.explanation: "rise" nội động từ; hiện tại hoàn thành: have risen.

questions.content: "Renewable energy" comes from sources that:
questions.explanation: Năng lượng tái tạo tự bổ sung.

questions.content: The lecture was so ____ that half the audience fell asleep.

Listen: "Please hand in your essays by the fifteenth of May. Late work will lose ten percent for each day."
What is the penalty for late work?

Listen: "Student: Which building is the science library in? Guide: It's behind the main hall, next to the café."
Where is the science library?

Listen: "The bus tour of the city takes about two hours and costs twenty-five pounds, including lunch."
What is included in the price?

Listen: "Tutor: Your presentation was clear, but you spoke too quickly. Try to slow down and pause between ideas."
What advice does the tutor give?

Listen: "The survey shows that forty percent of residents cycle to work at least once a week."
What proportion of residents cycle to work weekly?

Listen: "Officer: The lost property office is open from nine to one on weekdays."
When is the office open?
questions.explanation: Mở từ chín giờ đến một giờ.

questions.content:
Listen: "Student: I'd like to change my course. Advisor: You'll need to fill in a form and get your tutor's signature."
What does the student need?

Listen: "The conference will be held in Melbourne from the third to the sixth of October."
The conference lasts ____ days.
questions.explanation: Từ ngày 3 đến ngày 6 là bốn ngày.

questions.content: Complete with one word: Despite ____ tired, she finished the report.
Complete with the correct form of "take": He suggested ____ a taxi.
Complete with one word: The more you practise, ____ better you become.
questions.explanation: So sánh kép: the more ..., the better ...

questions.content: Complete with the correct form of "be": If I ____ you, I would accept the offer.
questions.explanation: Điều kiện loại 2: If I were you.

questions.content: Complete with the correct form of "write": The report ____ by the time we arrived. (past perfect passive)
questions.explanation: Quá khứ hoàn thành bị động.

questions.content: Complete with one word: She is interested ____ studying abroad.
Complete with one word: Not only ____ he late, but he also forgot his notes.
questions.explanation: Đảo ngữ sau "Not only": was he.

questions.content: Complete with one word: The number of visitors has increased ____ 20% since last year.
Complete with one word: This is the house ____ I was born.

descriptionVi: Đề rút gọn nâng cao với từ vựng và ngữ pháp band 7.
descriptionEn: An advanced shortened test with band 7 vocabulary and grammar.

questions.content:
Passage: Sleep researchers recommend that adults get seven to nine hours of sleep per night.
Statement: Adults need at least ten hours of sleep.

Passage: The novel was published in 1925 and has been translated into more than forty languages.
Statement: The novel has been translated into over forty languages.

Passage: Many cities have introduced congestion charges to reduce traffic. London introduced its charge in 2003.
Statement: The London charge is the highest in Europe.
questions.explanation: Không có thông tin so sánh mức phí.

questions.content:
Passage: Recycling paper saves trees, water and energy, but the process still creates some waste.
Statement: Recycling paper creates no waste.
questions.explanation: Quá trình vẫn tạo ra một ít rác.

questions.content:
Passage: The university has three campuses, and the largest, in the north of the city, hosts most science departments.
Statement: Most science departments are on the northern campus.
questions.explanation: Khuôn viên lớn nhất ở phía bắc chứa phần lớn khoa khoa học.

questions.content:
Passage: Researchers interviewed two hundred commuters about their journeys.
Statement: The commuters were interviewed in 2019.

Read: "Glaciers store about 70% of the world's fresh water, so their melting threatens future supplies."
Why is glacier melting a concern?
questions.explanation: Băng tan đe doạ nguồn nước ngọt.

questions.content:
Read: "Unlike mammals, reptiles cannot generate their own body heat and must rely on the sun."
How do reptiles warm their bodies?
questions.explanation: Bò sát phải dựa vào mặt trời.

questions.content:
Read: "The festival began as a small local market but now attracts over half a million visitors annually."
What is true about the festival?
questions.explanation: Từ chợ nhỏ thành lễ hội hơn nửa triệu khách.

options.content: It is still a small market

questions.content:
Read: "Rainforests cover about six percent of the Earth's surface but contain more than half of its plant and animal species."
Rainforests cover about ____ percent of the Earth's surface.
Choose the word closest in meaning to "ambiguous":
The two studies produced ____ results, so scientists remain uncertain.
questions.explanation: Kết quả mâu thuẫn khiến các nhà khoa học chưa chắc.

questions.content: The new law aims to ____ discrimination in the workplace.
To "undermine" someone's confidence means to:
Choose the antonym of "temporary":
Rapid urbanisation has put enormous ____ on public services.
"An overwhelming majority" means:
The town was completely ____ by the earthquake.

Listen: "Tutor: The seminar on climate policy has moved from room 204 to room 310."
What is the new room?

Listen: "The guided walk begins at ten thirty at the north gate and lasts about ninety minutes."
Where does the walk begin?

Listen: "Student: Do I have to buy the textbook? Lecturer: No, copies are available in the library."
Where can the student find the textbook?

Listen: "The average temperature in the region has risen by one point five degrees over the last fifty years."
By how much has the temperature risen?

Listen: "Advisor: Applications for the scholarship close on the twentieth of November."
When do applications close?

Listen: "Woman: Would you like the window seat? Man: I'd prefer the aisle. I need to stretch my legs."
Why does the man prefer the aisle?

options.content: He wants to stretch his legs

questions.content:
Listen: "Lecturer: There will be no lecture next week because I will be attending a conference."
Why will there be no lecture?

options.content: The lecturer is at a conference

questions.content:
Listen: "The exhibition features works by artists from twelve countries."
The exhibition includes works from ____ countries.
Complete with one word: Hardly ____ he sat down when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: Đảo ngữ: Hardly had + S + V3 ... when ...

questions.content: Complete with one word: She insisted ____ paying for dinner.
Complete with the correct form of "go": By next year, I ____ to university.
Complete with the correct form of "leave": It's high time we ____.
Complete with one word: He is used ____ getting up early.
Complete with one word: Neither of the answers ____ correct.

descriptionVi: Đề tổng hợp trình độ cơ bản: từ vựng, ngữ pháp, nghe, đọc và điền từ.
descriptionEn: A beginner mixed test: vocabulary, grammar, listening, reading and gap-fill.

questions.content: What is the opposite of "hot"?
"Breakfast" is a meal you eat in the ____.
questions.explanation: Bữa sáng ăn vào buổi sáng.

questions.content: A place where you borrow books is a ____.
I ____ a student.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ I đi với am.

questions.content: She ____ to school every day.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ ngôi thứ ba số ít thêm -es.

questions.content: There ____ two apples on the table.
This is my brother. ____ name is Tom.
questions.explanation: Tính từ sở hữu của "he" là his.

questions.content: I have ____ umbrella.
questions.explanation: "umbrella" bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm nên dùng an.

questions.content: We ____ football yesterday.
What time ____ you get up?
questions.explanation: Với "you" dùng trợ động từ do.

questions.content: The cat is ____ the table.
questions.explanation: Giới từ chỉ vị trí: under = ở dưới.

questions.content: Which word means "very big"?
My mother's sister is my ____.
questions.explanation: Chị/em gái của mẹ là dì (aunt).

questions.content: I'd like a cup of ____.
How much ____ this shirt?
questions.explanation: "this shirt" số ít nên dùng is.

questions.content:
Listen: "My name is Anna and I am twenty years old."
How old is Anna?

Listen: "The bank opens at nine o'clock and closes at five."
When does the bank close?

Listen: "Man: Can I have a coffee, please? Woman: Sure. Milk or sugar? Man: Milk, please."
What does the man want in his coffee?

Listen: "It is sunny in Hanoi today, but it is raining in Hue."
What is the weather in Hue?

Listen: "The bus to the airport leaves every twenty minutes."
How often does the bus leave?

Listen: "Tom has two sisters and one brother."
How many brothers and sisters does Tom have?

Read: "Mai lives in a small house near the sea. She likes swimming in summer."
Where does Mai live?

Read: "Lunch break is from twelve to one. The canteen is on the second floor."
Where is the canteen?

Read: "Sam has a dog called Lucky. Lucky likes to play in the park in the evening."
When does Lucky play in the park?

Read: "Sale! T-shirts are only ten dollars this week."
How much are the T-shirts?

Read: "Dear Ben, Happy birthday! Let's have dinner on Saturday at seven. Love, Amy."
When is the dinner?

Read: "The museum is closed on Mondays. It is open from ten to six on other days."
On which day is the museum closed?
Complete with one word: I ____ hungry now.
Complete with the correct form of "work": My father ____ in a bank.
questions.explanation: Ngôi thứ ba số ít thêm -s.

questions.content: Complete with one word: There ____ a book on the desk.
questions.explanation: "a book" số ít nên dùng is.

questions.content: Complete with the correct form of "tall": She is ____ than her sister.
Complete with one word: I get up ____ six o'clock.
Write the short form: We (do not) like coffee. → We ____ like coffee.
Complete with one word: ____ is your name?
Complete with the present continuous of "watch": He ____ TV now.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: is + V-ing.

questions.content: Complete with one word: How ____ apples do you want?
Complete with one word: I was born ____ 2001.
Complete with the past simple of "go": Yesterday, I ____ to the market.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ bất quy tắc của go là went.

questions.content: Complete with one word: This book is ____ (I).
Complete with the correct form of "beauty": Vietnam is a ____ country.
questions.explanation: Cần tính từ trước danh từ.
